reasons: F01, F02, F03, F04, F05, F06, F16, F17, F18, F19: clean governance/control profile - no material weakness, unqualified ICFR opinion, no auditor change or disagreements, no going concern, no disclosed SEC/government inquiries, litigation or covenant issues.
R09: Beneish M-score of -2.06 is below the -1.78 manipulation threshold; R02, R03, R05, R06, R07 indices are all near or below 1, showing no margin, asset-quality, depreciation or SG&A red flags.
R08, R10, R12: total and RSST accruals are low (0.01) and inventory build is small, consistent with mostly cash-backed earnings.

R01, R11, R18: DSRI of 1.25 and receivables growing 30 points faster than sales (with change in receivables 3% of avg assets) is the main ratio warning sign, suggesting possible aggressive revenue recognition or collection slowdown, though in a commodity merchandising business this can reflect price inflation and timing.
R17, R16, F21: Dechow F-score of 1.56 exceeds the 1.0 threshold, driven partly by securities issuance/capital raising, indicating above-average misstatement probability.
R19: operating cash flow at 0.8x net income is somewhat weak, meaning part of reported earnings is not yet converted to cash.
F14, F20: CEO/CFO change in the year combined with incentive pay tied to revenue/EPS raises pressure/opportunity for earnings management.
F11: material related-party transactions add a channel for non-arm's-length dealings that warrant scrutiny.
F07: an immaterial revision of prior periods indicates some prior accounting errors existed, albeit judged immaterial.
F26: emphasis on non-GAAP measures can mask GAAP performance and pressure segment/adjusted metrics.

F24, R13: inventory is a critical audit matter and soft assets are a high 82% of total assets, meaning a large share of the balance sheet relies on valuation judgment (commodity inventories at fair value).

F08, F09, F10, F22, F23, F25, F28: no over-time revenue, unbilled assets, bill-and-hold, major acquisition, SPAC, voluntary accounting change or segment change - several common fraud vectors are absent.
